articleBodyHtml:
Gameplay Moments

During the stream, the team encountered a Wraith that disappeared into a portal after being shot at. There was some uncertainty about whether this was due to enemy pushback or simply the Wraith's behavior. The team also discussed the possibility of reducing the amount of loot they would collect, with one member saying, 'Okay, we'll pick up less.'

The team emphasized the importance of working together, with one member saying, 'Team mate, let's go.' They also discussed the strategy of moving around the right side for better cover, indicating that the ring was going to be a key element in the gameplay.
